items.html: And afterwards, in the destruction of the Second Temple, there was the smallest diminution of all the times, and it is exactly like the time of the sin of the first man — like her being in the first aspect of Atzilut, back to back, being a point included of ten, namely her Malchut alone, back to back, under his Yesod. And a blemish was added in her: that those ten Sefirot of hers descended below, among the Klipot; and then “the supports were lost” (Samkhin Et'avidu), which are the NHY of ZA that support her.
